tool_args.rationale: The open-branch probe can distinguish candidate mechanisms using targeted observations before committing to a numerical fit.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot varies u_now and s_grad together, leaving the base response and gradient-dependent sink insufficiently identifiable.
The immediate ambiguity concerns the response branches rather than trajectory resolution; this probe costs more.
It does not address the mechanism ambiguity.
